visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of women and a man are clustered together in a dark, cave-like corridor. The walls are rugged and textured, illuminated by a faint yellow glow from an unseen source. The people have shocked facial expressions; one woman in the center has her hand tightly on the shoulder of the person in front of her. They move slowly and cautiously, looking around the dim environment. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a handheld radio sitting on a dark surface. The device has a small orange-lit screen displaying frequencies and several glowing buttons. Red indicator lights flicker on its side. The surrounding area is pitch black, focusing all visual attention on the mechanical object. (3) A woman holding a portable lantern walks through a dim space towards an old wooden desk. She reaches out with a shaky hand and pulls open a drawer. Inside, the drawer glows with a bright, warm light, revealing some papers or items within. The background remains very dark with some blurred wooden textures. (4) A man wearing a light-colored outdoor jacket stands behind a chain-link wire fence. He holds a bright flashlight that illuminates his face and the mesh of the fence. He is talking urgently, gesturing with his free hand. Behind him, the environment looks like an overgrown indoor set with hanging debris. (5) The group of participants follow the man through a narrow passage. The lead woman looks directly at the camera with a tense, wide-eyed expression. They are surrounded by rustic wooden beams and dark, shadowed corners. The lighting is inconsistent and flickering, creating a sense of unease. (6) A montage of rapid cuts shows a dark figure in a heavy, hooded cloak moving through a hallway bathed in deep red light. The camera shakes as it captures silhouettes of hands reaching out and people running away. The lighting flashes rapidly between red and complete darkness. (7) Four people sit side-by-side on a bench against a wooden wall. They look somber and serious, staring straight ahead. A hand enters the frame holding a small cross made of tied straw. The video ends with a movie-style poster featuring a close-up of a terrifying eye peeking through torn paper.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 你們敢在鬼月的時侯玩恐怖密室嗎. (2) [Subtitle]: 我們現在被風雨困在這裡. 土石流已經沖斷下山的路. 你們一定要聽我的指令. 我們才有辦法一起活下去好嗎. (3) [Subtitle]: 可以嗎… 好. 走…走嗎. 我是林向晴. 向著晴天的向晴. 好好你你好你好你好. 我們先去開燈. 走走走走走. 他黑眼圈好重. (4) [Slogan]: 上山前有些事你可能想要問的更清楚. 等你來挑戰. (5) [Logo]: 原創沉浸式劇場 親臨電影情節 改編自台灣真實山林傳說. [Logo]: 黃衣小飛俠 惡念 THE YELLOW TABOO.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Young adults in casual and outdoor clothing. One woman wears a black off-shoulder top, another in a white long-sleeve. The guide wears a light-colored outdoor utility jacket.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Dark corridors, cave-like rocky walls, wire fences, old wooden furniture, flickering oil lamps, red-lit hallways, and rustic indoor sets mimicking a haunted building.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-pitched female screams and frantic overlapping voices. The speech rate is extremely fast, and the tone is one of high anxiety and fear. A low, pulsating synthesizer drone serves as the background music. There are audible sounds of heavy footsteps and clothing rustling against a hard surface. (2) A loud 'whoosh' transition effect occurs, marking an editing cut. This is immediately followed by the crackling sound of radio static and a filtered male voice speaking with a sense of urgency. The voice has a mid-range pitch and a professional, narrative tone. The background music cuts out briefly during the radio transmission. (3) A sharp 'thud' SFX sounds, followed by a sudden burst of high-pitched female screaming. The background music returns with aggressive percussive hits and rising harmonic tension. The acoustic environment shifts to a more confined room tone with shorter reverb tails. (4) A man's voice enters, speaking in a calm but firm tone. His articulation is clear. In the background, there is a faint sound of artificial wind. A series of metallic clicks and the sound of a flashlight being toggled are heard under his speech. The BGM remains a low, tense bed. (5) Multiple loud, transient 'hit' SFX trigger in rapid succession, synced with the pace of visual cuts. High-tempo cinematic percussion begins, featuring heavy electronic drum beats. The crowd noise intensity spikes again with more screams and breathless gasps. (6) The music shifts to a slower, eerie piano melody with high harmonic tension. A woman's voice speaks in a soft, lower-arousal tone, sounding like a narrator. The ambient floor is very quiet, emphasizing the clarity and breathiness of her voice. (7) A final crescendo of distorted synthesizer noises and a loud stinger SFX ends the track. There is a brief moment of silence before a final, muffled thudding sound and a high-frequency digital UI chime.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Immersion -> Climax -> Info Reveal
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote an immersive horror theater experience based on the Taiwanese 'Yellow Taboo' legend. The video uses intense sensory cues and fast-paced editing to attract viewers to participate in the event.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is a direct advertisement for a specific theater show with a title card and brand logos at the end.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-intensity promotional material for an escape room or immersive theater. Relies heavily on audio-visual jump scares.
